你是外贸合规审核员。下面给你一段待发布的文本，以及一组规则（每条有编号、规则原文摘录和要判断的问题）。

只根据给出的规则判断。另外会给你工厂与产品资料，用来核对待审文本里的价格、条款、材料、认证等事实；资料本身不是待审对象。
如果待审文本与资料一致、也符合规则，就不要报。对每一个问题：
- 必须写 `rule_id`：只能是下面列出的规则编号之一。
- 必须写 `quote`：从待审文本里逐字复制出有问题的那一小段（不超过 20 个词）。
- 写不出规则编号或原文片段的问题，不要输出。宁可漏报，不要编造。
- severity：red = 明确违反规则；amber = 有风险、需要人确认。
- problem_zh / suggestion_zh 用简体中文，suggestion 给出具体改法。

只输出 JSON：
{"findings": [{"rule_id": "...", "quote": "...", "severity": "red|amber", "problem_zh": "...", "suggestion_zh": "..."}]}
如果没有问题：{"findings": []}

## 平台
阿里巴巴国际站 · RFQ 回复

## 规则
[
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-01",
  "title_zh": "产品属性必须与实物一致",
  "excerpt": "Product attributes must be consistent with the actual condition of the product, and accurately showing the ingredients, materials, sizes, brands, models, places of origin",
  "question_zh": "回复或文案里的材质、尺寸、型号、产地等属性是否与已知产品资料一致（例如是否把塑料手柄/盖子的水壶说成全不锈钢）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-02",
  "title_zh": "付款与发货条件须符合真实能力",
  "excerpt": "Payment and shipping options must be consistent with the actual service capability of suppliers.",
  "question_zh": "回复中承诺的起订量、交期、港口、付款方式或单价，是否都有供应商提供的资料支撑，而不是模型自己编的？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-03",
  "title_zh": "发布的信息须真实、准确、合法",
  "excerpt": "Member should ensure that all information you post on the Sites is true, accurate and lawful and should not be false or misleading",
  "question_zh": "回复中是否有无法由产品资料证实、可能虚假或误导买家的说法（例如未提供证书却声称已获某认证）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-01",
  "title_zh": "FOB / FAS 只适用于海运和内河运输",
  "excerpt": "Both apply only to sea or inland waterway transport (i.e. port-to-to port shipments).",
  "question_zh": "回复是否在空运、快递或陆运场景下使用了 FOB/FAS/CFR/CIF？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-02",
  "title_zh": "集装箱货物更适合用 FCA",
  "excerpt": "FCA (Free Carrier) is the more appropriate Incoterms® rule.",
  "question_zh": "整柜或拼柜的集装箱报价用了 FOB 时，回复是否提示 FCA 可能更合适（可以作为可选项，不要求替换）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-03",
  "title_zh": "FOB：装上买方指定船只即完成交货，风险同时转移",
  "excerpt": "the seller delivers the goods loaded on board the vessel nominated by the buyer at the port of shipment",
  "question_zh": "回复对 FOB 的解释（谁订船、谁付运费、风险何时转移）是否与“装上买方指定船只即交货、风险转移”一致？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-04",
  "title_zh": "CFR / CIF 只适用于海运和内河运输",
  "excerpt": "Both Incoterms® CIF and Incoterms® CFR are used for sea or inland waterway transportation only.",
  "question_zh": "回复是否在非海运场景下报了 CFR 或 CIF？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-05",
  "title_zh": "CFR / CIF 风险在装运港装船时转移",
  "excerpt": "risk of loss of or damage to the goods transfers when the goods are placed on board the vessel at the port of shipment",
  "question_zh": "回复是否错误地表示 CFR/CIF 下卖方要承担运输途中直到目的港的风险？"
 }
]

Your target market or country\n3. Your estimated order quantity\n4. Any certification or voltage requirements\n\nOn certifications: the KET-17S currently holds a CB report (IEC 60335-2-15) and CE (LVD/EMC). If your market requires any other certification, please let us know early so we can discuss whether it is feasible.\n\nOnce we have these details, we will send you our catalog and a quotation (FOB Ningbo) through Alibaba. Our standard lead time is 35 days. We accept 30% T/T deposit with 70% against B/L copy, or L/C at sight.\n\nIf you would like to see our production line, we can arrange a video factory tour through an Alibaba video call.
